name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with a wide stance over a barbell, turn your toes outward roughly 45 degrees, and grip the bar straight down inside your knees.
Pull your chest upright, engage your lats to remove slack, and drive your knees outward over your toes.
Push the floor apart smoothly through both feet to extend your hips and knees until standing tall.
Hinge back at your hips and bend your knees to lower the bar smoothly back to the floor.
tips: Keep your knees tracking outward in line with your toes throughout the pull.
Keep the bar grazing close against your shins and finish tall without leaning backward.
